generation_implications: For Broad/Axl-like bodies, preserve a standard-compatible lower-body frame while allowing a much wider upper BodyEnvelopeProfile.
Do not estimate Axl shoulder pivots from armour silhouette width.
Represent the standard torso core, outer shell, and special arms as separate components in the digital twin.
Train architecture recognition to distinguish hybrid-shell bodies from uniformly scaled figures.
Use visual fitting for mass/silhouette and component-frame evidence for mechanical alignment.
validation_queue: Acquire or scan a physical 23763/24128 assembly.
Measure left/right arm pinhole centers relative to the standard 973 frame.
Measure shell neck and back-stud frames.
Measure dedicated 24101/24104 arm mating geometry and articulation sweep.
Replace provisional source-mesh values with physical measurements where they disagree.
hard_rules: Unofficial LDraw geometry is not manufacturing authority.
BrickLink inventory proves component identity better than geometry.
Do not convert forum-reported coordinates into production connector dimensions without physical validation.
